I like to use Mochiko rice flour for this, since it's a bit sweeter than wheat flour.

.5 pound butter
2 C sugar
4 eggs
1/3 C lemon zest
.5 C fresh lemon juice
2.5 C Mochiko Sweet Rice Flour
1 tsp baking soda
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp salt

  • Preheat oven to 350°F
  • Grease two standard loaf pans and with parchment paper line the bottoms.
  • Cream butter and sugar until pale yellow in color. Add eggs one at a time, then lemon zest and juice.
  • Mix dry ingredients thoroughly in a separate bowl and then add to wet mixture a little at a time.
  • Divide mixture between the two loaf pans.
  • Bake for 45 – 60 minutes. Remove from pan while still warm, remove paper from bottoms.

Syrup Glaze: ¾ C lemon juice (strained of pulp, etc.) ¼ C lemon zest ¾ C sugar

  • Combine all ingredients in a small heavy saucepan and bring to a slow boil and simmer for approximately 10 minutes.
  • Prick loafs all over, top and bottom, and pour syrup over loaves

Can be served warm or cooled.
